_comment: Customer-facing strings for reports and emails. This tree IS linted by scripts/jargon-lint.js (master §4 blocklist + register). Change copy here, never inline in renderer code.

report.money_headline_waste: About {amount} a month is going to waste
report.money_headline_clean: No money leaks found this week
report.cumulative_strip: {fixes} fixes applied since day one · about {amount} of waste removed
report.locked_placeholder: {count} {noun} found — unlock the full report to see the list and the fix
report.locked_fix_placeholder: The exact fix is in the full report
report.unlock_cta: Unlock the full report — $20, credited to your first month
report.degraded_notice: Part of this check could not run this week ({reasons}). Everything shown is complete; nothing is guessed.
report.footer_note: We check your ads, your visit tracking and your site every week, and fix what you approve.

deep.money_picture_sub: What you spent against what the same weeks would have cost with the measured waste removed. The gap is the leak.
deep.cpa_curve_sub: A healthy account matures toward a floor. A jump off the floor usually means counting changed or ads are relearning.
deep.leaks_sub: Green is money already recovered, gray is calendar waste, red is still bleeding.
deep.qs_title: Quality rating: the structural per-click premium
deep.qs_sub: Google rates every search's fit from 1 to 10 and prices clicks by it. Low ratings pay a premium for the same position.
deep.hours_sub: Spend and cost per result, hour by hour. Flagged hours pay a multiple of your usual price per result.
deep.headroom_sub: The share of interested clicks you win today. The rest of the market is reachable at a measured pace.
deep.copy_title: What your ads say, and what Google chooses to serve
deep.register_sub: Each change is itemised, reversible, and applied only after your approval.
deep.unexamined_sub: These datasets were not part of this check. Nothing here is guessed; absence is stated, never papered over.
deep.modelled_note: Figures marked modelled are careful estimates, shown apart from measured figures on purpose.
deep.locked_table: {count} rows in the full report, each with the exact fix
deep.email_deep_strip: This week's full report carries the charts, the complete tables and the change register.
